rule:
PYTHONPATH=src python data/evaluation/stage2/device/look-agreement/build_draft_events.py

Pool, in this order, keeping the first candidate of every distinct draft-v2 prompt (greedy decoding gives the
same draft for the same prompt, so repeated prompts add nothing):
  A. every candidate with a visual-check description in the demo-night jobs (data/evaluation/stage2/device/night/jobs,
     checked on the device) and in the stored jobs (.runtime/jobs, checked on the CPU);
  B. the Stage I candidate groups as the app forms them (server.normalize_vision on the detector records of the
     phase2 cohort, three profiles), each with the published CPU look-v2 answer of its key pair
     (data/evaluation/look/results.json) as its visual check.
A gave 7 distinct candidates, so B fills the set to 20: its distinct candidates in the order of the SHA-256 of
their prompt. The split for choosing a device format hint alternates over the 20 in that order (A first, then B):
positions 0, 2, 4, ... form the selection half and 1, 3, 5, ... the held-out half.
Writes draft_events.json next to this script.
